steps.t: Finish the story first: the 100% Completion checklist only becomes viewable afterwards, under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, and progress made during the story already counts.
Work the checklist as the spine of Stage 2: story and tasks, robberies and fencing totals, collectibles, activities and discovery.
Mind the two-number items: the checklist asks less than the trophies in places — 15 of 18 meditations, 15 of 18 card sets — and more in others, like 300 of 397 stunts where the trophy asks 250.
Nothing on the checklist is permanently missable: everything on it can still be done in free roam after the credits.
Clear the full-clear robbery block: 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loans and all 8 vaults are required in full.
Take the fencing totals as they come: $100,000 narcotics, $100,000 jewelry, $250,000 marked bills and $200,000 vehicles.
Work the exploration lines with slack where it exists: 100 of 125 flamingos, 30 of 34 magazines, 70 of 79 styles, 90 of 100 hoops.
Finish the lines that demand everything: 33 underwater discoveries, 42 range golds, 42 drone trials and Bret's 15 target decks.
Close out Discovery: scan 200 of 277 base model vehicles, hold 50 of 66 standard weapons once, study 100 animals through binoculars.
Leave the 80 challenges late: the checklist needs 70, the trophy only 50, and most complete themselves along the way.

trophies.disagreement: Trophy: 250 stunts [6]. Checklist: 300 of the same 397 [7][13]. Plan for 300 if chasing A Long Road. Whether a plain stunt counts is unsettled: PowerPyx [51] and EGamers [75] say performing it counts; Output Lag [70] leaves it open and marks a jump Completed only once its challenge is done. County splits differ too: Vice-Dale 55, Lummox 16 [51] against 53 and 19 at IGN [63].

facts.t: Its official description reads: “Complete 250 Stunts.”
It is a silver trophy.
It is not hidden on PlayStation.
The game holds 397 stunts in four types.
130 of them are stunt jumps over ramps.
202 are under-the-bridge flights, the biggest group.
40 are knife flights between buildings and 25 are base jumps.
The 100% checklist wants 300 of the 397, more than this trophy.
One successful attempt completes a stunt; repeats do not add.
Progress can be tracked by region in Progress > Activities > Stunts.
On Xbox it is worth 40 of the list's 1,000 Gamerscore.
On GTABase's weighted checklist, the stunts line is worth 1%.
Under-the-bridge flights are the quickest stunt category to bank.

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts of the game's 397 — skip the worst landings; the 100% checklist separately asks 300.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

steps.t: Complete 250 stunts of any mix: the 397 in the game split into stunt jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps.
Start with the 202 under-the-bridge flights: PowerPyx and GameMapa both call them the quickest stunts to bank.
Work the 130 stunt jumps region by region while travelling for other trophies.
Take knife flights (40) and base jumps (25) as you pass their markers rather than in one session.
Track progress by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, and by name on the map's Stunt Spots filter.
Clear stunts region by region while travelling for other trophies instead of saving all 250 for one session.
If you are also chasing A Long Road, keep going afterwards: its checklist wants 300 of the 397.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.

facts.t: Its official description reads: “Try each type of activity once.”
It is a bronze trophy.
It is not hidden on PlayStation.
The trophy tracker counts 9 types of activity.
The nine are fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt.
One attempt at each type is enough; depth is rewarded elsewhere.
Most types are introduced automatically during the story.
Activities are viewed under Touchpad > Progress > Activities.
On the map they carry blue dumbbell icons once unfogged.
On Xbox it is worth 20 of the list's 1,000 Gamerscore.

trophies.guide: Sample every activity type once — the cheapest trophy on the list, a first-evening target.
trophies.name: Master of None

steps.t: Try each activity type at least once: races, ranges, drone races, fishing, arcade games, meditation, hunting, stunts and challenges — the spread the other trophies are built from.
One attempt at each type is enough; depth is rewarded by the other trophies, not this one.
Tick the water and field types early: one fishing attempt, one hunt and one stunt are all on the story's route.
Tick the venue types as you pass them: a race, a shooting range, a pool game, a basketball hoop and one video game.
Check the spread under Progress > Activities as you go: it shows which of the nine types you have not tried yet.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.disagreement: Hardest trophy: PowerPyx and GTABase name A Long Road alone [1][15]; GamesFuze names A Long Road and The Shootist together [23]. Every checklist read agrees on the 42 golds. The ranges split too: GTABase and GameTrek spread the 42 golds across 12 ranges [2][34]; PowerPyx and Push Square name two venues — Griffin (18) and Rodgers Ranch (24) [7][3].

facts.t: Its official description reads: “Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.”
It is a silver trophy.
It is not hidden on PlayStation.
There are 42 gold medals to earn.
The challenges sit at 2 ranges: Griffin and Rodgers Ranch.
Griffin holds 18 of the golds and Rodgers Ranch 24.
Each range's challenges unlock with a $5 waiver pass from the clerk.
The 100% checklist also demands all 42 golds, with no slack.
Challenges are timed courses or target scores.
Range challenges also raise your Focus stat.
On Xbox it is worth 40 of the list's 1,000 Gamerscore.
On GTABase's weighted checklist, the range golds line is worth 1%.

trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges; silver and bronze do not count.
trophies.name: The Shootist

steps.t: Earn a gold medal in each of the 42 Shooting Range challenges; the 100% checklist counts the same 42 golds.
Buy the $5 waiver pass from the clerk at each range first: that is what marks its challenges on the map.
Clear Griffin's 18 golds, then move to Rodgers Ranch for its 24.
Learn one weapon class at a time and replay a range immediately while its target pattern is fresh, rather than doing one pass of every range and returning weeks later.
Track what is left under Progress > Activities > Shooting Ranges.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.disagreement: Trophy: a race win at every location [6]. Checklist: all 42 time trials completed — PowerPyx notes the third trial at each location needs only a finish, not a par time [7]. Do the checklist version; the trophy is covered.

facts.t: Its official description reads: “Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.”
It is a bronze trophy.
It is not hidden on PlayStation.
There are 14 drone race locations.
Each location runs 3 time trials, 42 in total.
Beating par on the first two trials unlocks the third.
The third trial only needs a finish for the checklist.
The 100% checklist demands all 42 trials completed.
Locations are marked with blue icons within about 100 metres.
Progress sits under Progress > Activities > Top Fun Drones.
On Xbox it is worth 15 of the list's 1,000 Gamerscore.
On GTABase's weighted checklist, the drone trials line is worth 1%.

trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each location; finishing is not enough.
trophies.name: Top Fun

steps.t: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations the list counts.
Learn a course with one exploratory run, then race it properly; tick each location off here as you win it.
At each location, beat the par time on the first two trials to unlock the third.
Finish the third trial at every location as well: the checklist wants all 42 trials, not just the wins.
Hold the stick forward the whole run and avoid crashes; PowerPyx's drone notes call that the par-time difference.

trophies.disagreement: Race Challenge golds: PowerPyx, GTABase, Insider Gaming and TimeSaver say 10 of 13 [7][24][13][20]; Push Square's checklist says 30 [14]; Shacknews's says 42 [8]. The trophy's 20 race wins are undisputed. The pool size itself splits the guides: PowerPyx [58] and EGamers [81] list 40 races, while IGN's race guide covers 39 [66].

facts.t: Its official description reads: “Win 20 different races.”
It is a bronze trophy.
It is not hidden on PlayStation.
The wins must be 20 different races; repeats do not count.
The game holds 40 unique races in total.
The 100% checklist wants 30 of those 40 won.
Separate from the races are 13 Race Challenges with medals.
Races appear as blue icons when you come within about 100 metres.
Wins per race group are tracked under Progress > Activities > Racing.
No source flags it missable; races stay in free roam.
On GTABase's weighted checklist, the unique races line is worth 1%.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races; the same race twenty times does not count.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

steps.t: Win 20 different races, as the official description requires — repeats of one race do not count.
Spread the wins across the map as new races open during the story, and keep the distinct-race count here.
Use the map filter (Activities > Racing) to find the 40 unique races; they mark themselves within about 100 metres.
If you are chasing the checklist too, keep going to 30 wins: that is its line, and it covers this trophy with room to spare.
Treat the 13 Race Challenges as a separate medal hunt; they are not the same counter as race wins.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.

facts.t: Its official description reads: “Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.”
It is a bronze trophy.
It is not hidden on PlayStation.
Cal is met in the Chapter 1 main mission Feng Shui.
After that mission, Cal texts you and marks a fishing spot west of Key Lento.
The marked spot carries a purple map icon.
Cal's fishing challenges also count as optional tasks toward the 100% checklist.
Fishing is one of the nine activity types Master of None samples.
No source flags the challenge as one-shot or missable.
Fishing also raises the Focus stat behind Combat Focus.

trophies.guide: Beat Cal, the named fishing character, at his fishing challenge.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

steps.t: Take Cal's fishing challenge when his strand offers it and fish it out to the scoring end.
If you lose, treat the first attempt as practice for where the fish run and take the challenge again; nothing published suggests it is one-shot.
Watch for his text after Feng Shui in Chapter 1: it marks the fishing location west of Key Lento with a purple icon.
You need a boat with a fishing rod for the challenge: if you do not own one, hijack one near the marked spot.

trophies.disagreement: PowerPyx, on this trophy: completing a game means finishing all its levels once [1]. On the checklist's Video Games Played line, it says starting each of the four games is enough [7]. The trophy is stricter: finish a whole game.

facts.t: Its official description reads: “Complete an arcade game.”
It is a bronze trophy.
It is not hidden on PlayStation.
The game calls its four arcade games Video Games.
They are Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind and Bang For Your Buck.
Three of them are played at the TV in your home.
Bang For Your Buck is only on arcade machines around the world.
The home TV is inaccessible for part of Chapter 2 and returns from Chapter 3.
The checklist's Video Games Played line needs all 4 started.
Playing a video game is one of Master of None's nine activity types.
The four games are tracked under Progress > Activities > Games.

trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game, start to finish, at any Leonida cabinet.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

steps.t: Complete one arcade game from start to finish at any cabinet you find.
Pick the shortest game you come across during the story instead of making a special trip at the end; quitting mid-game does not count, because the description asks for a completed game.
The home TV offers three of the games from Chapter 1: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind.
To complete one, finish all of its levels once; you do not need its challenge medals.
Save Bang For Your Buck, the arcade-only game, for the checklist's set of four rather than this trophy.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.disagreement: TechWiser reports story-progress windows on the chains behind the five finales [10]. PowerPyx says unavailable quest givers return; Andy's line is Chapter 3, Lucia-only, quests available after the story [1].

facts.t: Its official description reads: “Complete the final mission for Andy.”
It is a bronze trophy.
PlayStation hides it until earned.
Andy's questline is exclusive to Lucia.
The line is marked automatically during Chapter 3, when Andy calls Lucia.
Andy then texts her home address, which marks the line in Belville.
The strand runs five quests, ending with Puff Puff Pass.
PowerPyx says all of Andy's quests remain available after the story.
PowerPyx also says Andy's line does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.
Her quests still count as optional tasks toward the 100% checklist.

trophies.guide: Finish Andy's stranger strand — WATCH-flagged: sources disagree on whether its window can close.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

steps.t: Start Andy's strand when it is offered and complete its missions through to his final mission.
Published character notes report Andy's strand as Lucia-only, so work it while playing as Lucia.
Do not bank the finale for the cleanup until you have read the disagreement below: the window question is unsettled.
Take her call in Chapter 3 and follow the texted address to Belville to open the line.
Work the Cellerica quests in order: Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee and Peach!.
Finish with Read the Label and the finale, Puff Puff Pass at the warehouse.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.disagreement: (1) Window: TechWiser reports story-progress windows on these chains [10]; PowerPyx names Kenton temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1 but back in Chapters 2–3, quests available after the story [1]. (2) Treasures: The Games Wiki tallies 36 pieces — 41 across the seven sites [18].

facts.t: Its official description reads: “Complete the final mission for Kenton.”
It is a bronze trophy.
PlayStation hides it until earned.
Kenton's full name is Kenton Rees.
His line starts in Chapter 1, after Island Dreams, with a call and a green KR icon in Key Lento.
He sets treasure-diving quests over 7 shipwrecks.
His sets carry the 33 underwater discoveries the checklist demands in full.
He becomes temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1 and returns in Chapters 2–3.
Calling Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 can bring his text sooner.
Progress is tracked under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees.

trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's strand to his final mission. WATCH-flagged: same unsettled window question as the other finales.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

steps.t: Start Kenton's strand when it is offered and complete its missions through to his final mission.
If Kenton is not there when you look, that alone is not a lockout under the PowerPyx reading — but the TechWiser reading says not to test it; see the disagreement below.
Follow his purple chest markers: dive each wreck and dig the treasure up with the metal detector.
Return each set to his shop; he calls you back and marks more wrecks, seven in all.
If he vanishes after Chapter 1, play on: he returns between Chapters 2 and 3, and calling Brian as Jason can hurry his text.
Clear all 7 sets even though the checklist needs 5: the underwater discoveries line needs the wrecks anyway.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.disagreement: TechWiser reports story-progress windows on these chains [10]; PowerPyx says Billy's line is marked after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, runs five quests from the Thrillbilly Mudclub, stays available after the story [1].

facts.t: Its official description reads: “Complete the final mission for Billy.”
It is a bronze trophy.
PlayStation hides it until earned.
Billy's line is marked after Chapter 2's Coffee Break.
It starts at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
The strand runs five quests, ending with Hometown Heroes.
One of the quests is stealing a car called the Impaler.
PowerPyx says all of Billy's quests remain available after the story.
PowerPyx also says Billy's line does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.
His quests still count as optional tasks toward the 100% checklist.

trophies.guide: Finish Billy's strand at his final mission. WATCH-flagged for the unsettled window question.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

steps.t: Start Billy's strand when it is offered and complete its missions through to his final mission.
Work the strand in order as its missions appear rather than leaving the finale sitting while the main story advances.
Find the line at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County once Coffee Break is done.
Work the job quests in order: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab and Mall Rats.
Steal the Impaler, then finish with Hometown Heroes for the trophy.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.disagreement: The description says 8 stranger strands [6]; KeenGamer calls them “qualifying” strands without naming them [9]. PowerPyx names the confirmed counters — Kirk, Kyle, Yago, Pilot Pete, more being discovered — and says the Andy, Billy, Tyrone, Moses and Yasmani lines do NOT count [1].

facts.t: Its official description reads: “Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.”
It is a silver trophy.
It is not hidden on PlayStation.
The count is 8 completed strands.
PowerPyx says only certain questlines count as strangers for it.
Confirmed counting strands include Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete.
Kirk's line is the Skunk Ape hunt, in three quests.
The trophy tracker in the trophy list shows your strand count.
Strangers remain findable in free roam after the story.
Stranger quests also count as optional tasks toward the 100% checklist.
On Xbox it is worth 30 of the list's 1,000 Gamerscore.

trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger strands; the five character finales do not count toward them.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

steps.t: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands anywhere in Leonida, as the official description requires.
Do not count the five character finales toward this silver: PowerPyx says those questlines do not count as strangers here — see the disagreement box.
Start with Kirk's Skunk Ape line: Search for the Skunk Ape, Search for Tree Effigies, then Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove.
Add Kyle's three quests (McKittrick Farm, Collect Chemicals, Buddy?) and Yago's four race quests.
Add Pilot Pete's delivery line, The Last Mile and Pete's Deliveries.
Watch the trophy tracker in the trophy list for the running count, and sweep any strands still missing in free roam.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.disagreement: TechWiser reports story-progress windows on these chains [10]; PowerPyx says Randy's Wish List opens in Chapter 3, is map-tracked, can still be done after the story [1]. The list's size is also unsettled: 16 cars at PowerPyx and The Games Wiki [1][48], 18 at GTA6Heists [67], and Push Square's work-in-progress list counts 22 [50].

facts.t: Its official description reads: “Complete the final mission for Randy.”
It is a bronze trophy.
PlayStation hides it until earned.
Randy's line is called Randy's Wish List.
It opens in Chapter 3's Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, which also gives you the Key Cloner.
He wants 16 named sports cars delivered.
He is marked with a green RK icon in the west of Vice City.
His wanted cars cluster around the hotels of Vice Beach and Ocean Beach.
His deliveries also feed the checklist's $200,000 vehicles fenced line, at $35,000 or more a car.
PowerPyx says the Wish List can still be completed after the story.
A wishlist car in perfect condition pays $35,000 or more.

trophies.guide: Complete Randy's strand to his final mission. WATCH-flagged for the unsettled window question.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

steps.t: Start Randy's strand when it is offered and complete its missions through to his final mission.
Count it toward the 8 strands Strangers & Freaks needs once the finale is done.
Play Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS in Chapter 3: delivering the Zorrusso opens the Wish List and the Key Cloner.
Scan high-end sports cars with WAiNK: a popup tells you when one is on his list.
Work the marked cars first — Pegassi, Grotti and Pfister sports cars around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach.
Deliver each car undamaged where you can: condition sets the payout, and the payouts carry the vehicle fencing total.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.disagreement: TechWiser reports story-progress windows on these chains [10]; PowerPyx says Tyrone's line opens after Chapter 3's Here, Kitty Kitty, is Jason-only, stays available after the story [1].

facts.t: Its official description reads: “Complete the final mission for Tyrone.”
It is a bronze trophy.
PlayStation hides it until earned.
Tyrone's line is only available playing as Jason.
It opens after Chapter 3's Here, Kitty Kitty.
The work is destroying his Synthetic Labs, marked purple in Vice City.
The line runs two quests: Take Out Kitty Litter, then Spin On This.
His labs also count as optional tasks toward the 100% checklist.
PowerPyx says the line remains available after the story.
PowerPyx also says Tyrone's line does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's strand at his final mission. WATCH-flagged for the unsettled window question.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

steps.t: Start Tyrone's strand when it is offered and complete its missions through to his final mission.
Published notes mark Tyrone's strand as Jason-only, so switch to Jason when you work it.
After Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3, follow the purple markers to his Synthetic Labs in Vice City.
Destroy enough labs in Take Out Kitty Litter and Tyrone hands you the finale, Spin On This.
Destroy the purple-marked Synthetic Labs around Vice City until Tyrone offers the finale.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.disagreement: (1) Count: 18 meditations — both leads at a spot counts twice [1][7]; the checklist requires only 15 of the 18 [7][8]. This counter tracks 18. (2) The Chapter 1 balcony session adds +1 but is not a marked spot; whether the trophy requires it is unconfirmed [1] — do it anyway. (3) Wording: PowerPyx's checklist says “18 Meditation Spots across 10 locations” [7]; its locations page says 18 meditations across 10 spots [12]. (4) Missable label: Mobalytics names Strangers & Freaks the only missable [30]; the guides followed here flag this one [1][15].

facts.t: Its official description reads: “Meditate at every spot across Leonida.”
It is a bronze trophy.
It is not hidden on PlayStation.
There are 18 meditations across 10 spot locations.
Eight spots count twice, once per lead; the house and the summit count once.
The first meditation, at Jason's house, is Chapter 1 only.
Both leads are playable together after Chapter 2's Coffee Break.
The 100% checklist needs only 15 of the 18 meditations.
It is the only trophy the published guides flag as possibly missable.
Meditating raises the Focus stat behind Combat Focus.
The count lives under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.
On GTABase's weighted checklist, the meditations line is worth 1%.
Each meditation also counts as one optional task toward the checklist.
A meditation only counts once the closing zen animation has played.

trophies.guide: The one trophy guides flag as possibly missable; the counter tracks 18 meditations at spots shared by both leads.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

steps.t: In Chapter 1, the morning after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house, follow her to the balcony and accept the meditation she offers.
Keep a Chapter 1 manual save until this trophy has popped: that balcony session disappears with the chapter.
Meditate at the spots across Leonida with both leads: there are 18 meditations in total across 10 locations, and meditating together counts twice at a spot.
Leave the last spots until both characters are playable together, which the roadmap places after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.
Track the count in Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations, and against the counter here.
Smooth Sand: the sandbar off the west coast of Capri in Mariana County; meditate as both leads (meditations 2–3).
Swamp: the wooden dock by the lookout tower in Buckskin Swamp, Kelly County (meditations 4–5).
Worn Stone: the Emerald River bank at Camp Moonflower, Kelly County (meditations 6–7).
Red Rocks: Manifest Canyon in Kelly County, where the rail tracks cross the highway (meditations 8–9).
Water Wheel: the ruined paper mill on the river in south Moreau, Lummox County (meditations 10–11).
Jutting Cliff: the tower ledge overlooking the mine in Mount Kalaga National Park (meditations 12–13).
Waterfall: northwest of Tallaloko in Lummox County, above the east-flowing river (meditations 14–15).
Seaside: the rocky outcrop on the beach east of Waning Sands, Leonard County (meditations 16–17).
Ascent Mountain: the stone circle on Mount Kalaga's summit; it is only marked once every other meditation is done, and it is the 18th.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.

facts.t: Its official description reads: “Hunt a unique animal for Bret.”
It is a bronze trophy.
PlayStation hides it until earned.
Bret's full name is Bret Vogel.
His questline is exclusive to Jason; Lucia cannot receive his text.
It is marked after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, by a text from Bret.
His first quest is Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County.
He gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69.
His strand runs 15 target decks, all required by the 100% checklist.
PowerPyx says which animal exactly unlocks this trophy is still unconfirmed.
Clean one-shot kills keep an animal pristine and pay more.
His decks are tracked under Map > Activities > Target Deck.

trophies.guide: Take Bret's hunting strand and hunt the unique animal he sends you after; which animal pops it is unconfirmed (PowerPyx).
trophies.name: Fair Game

steps.t: Work Bret's hunting content and hunt the unique animal his strand sends you after, as the official description requires.
Bret also sits behind the target decks in the 100% checklist (15 of 15), so his strand feeds A Long Road as well.
Play as Jason after Coffee Break and answer Bret's text: Veteran Hunted in Lummox County opens the line.
Take the Killtelligence SM-69 from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker once he gives it to you.
Work his purple hunting markers in order and bring each requested animal back to him as Jason.

trophies.disagreement: Trophy: 3 complete sets [6]. Checklist: 15 of the 18 sets [7][15]. Treat 15 as the real target.

facts.t: Its official description reads: “Complete 3 Collectible Card sets.”
It is a silver trophy.
It is not hidden on PlayStation.
The game holds 480 collectible cards in 18 sets.
Sets run from 12 to 36 cards each.
The 100% checklist wants 15 of the 18 sets completed.
Some cards exist in more than one location as duplicates.
Any card can be sold to a pawn shop for cash.
Sets are tracked under Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards.
The sets cover sports teams, wrestlers, comic heroes and club dancers.
On Xbox it is worth 30 of the list's 1,000 Gamerscore.
On GTABase's weighted checklist, the card sets line is worth 1%.

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 full card sets for this silver; the checklist separately wants 15 of 18 sets.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

steps.t: Complete any 3 full collectible card sets, as the official description requires.
Keep a set-by-set count here, not just a card total: the game holds 18 sets, and the 100% checklist asks for 15 of them.
Start with the small sets: Backyard Wrestling has 12 cards and Delights Dancers 18.
Work the 24-card sports sets next: the Vice City, Liberty City and Los Santos team sets.
Leave the 36-card sets (the dancer and comic sets) for the checklist push to 15.
Check duplicates before a long trip: some cards spawn in more than one place.

trophies.disagreement: PowerPyx's database counts 112 WAiNK locations: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures, 23 No Flusher tags [17]. The Games Wiki counts 108 in five types — 15 No Flusher tags, 4 Peewees Billboards — and notes menu counts disagree [18]. The trophy needs any 100.

facts.t: Its official description reads: “WAiNK It at 100 locations.”
It is a silver trophy.
It is not hidden on PlayStation.
A scan is made on foot by holding up on the pad and R1 with the phone out.
The game tells you on screen when a scannable location is near.
Landmarks account for 31 of the locations.
Curiosities account for 35 and sculptures for 23.
The 100% checklist counts the same 100 scans.
Scans are tracked under Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations.
The same app scans vehicles, so one habit feeds two trophies.
On Xbox it is worth 30 of the list's 1,000 Gamerscore.
On GTABase's weighted checklist, the WAiNK scans line is worth 1%.

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations — a from-the-start habit, not an endgame grind.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

steps.t: WAiNK It at 100 different locations, as the official description requires; the 100% checklist counts the same 100 scans.
Turn on collectible notifications and WAiNK new places as you travel, because backtracking 100 locations at the end is the slow way to earn this silver.
Sweep the landmarks first (31) and the curiosities (35): together they are two-thirds of the target.
Add the sculptures (23) as you cross the city; they sit in the same districts as the landmarks.
Finish with the tags and billboards, whose totals the sources dispute — see the disagreement box.
Scan on foot: the popup only fires when you are walking, not in a vehicle.

trophies.disagreement: Trophy: 50 challenges [6]. Checklist: 70 of the same 80 [7][20]. Finish 70 and both are satisfied. Insider Gaming puts even the trophy bar at 70 of 80 [37]; the official description's 50 is followed here. Throttled also splits: PowerPyx says holding over 100 mph for 2 minutes [36]; Games.gg and Sportskeeda say 2 miles [41][42].

facts.t: Its official description reads: “Complete 50 Challenges.”
It is a bronze trophy.
It is not hidden on PlayStation.
The game holds 80 challenges in 8 categories of 10.
The categories are Combat, Criminal, Exploration, Fitness, Shopping, Sports, Survival and Vehicle.
All 80 are available from the start of the game.
The 100% checklist wants 70 of the 80.
Five in a category, then all ten, each unlock a spawn-vehicle cheat.
Completed challenges show a checkmark under Progress > Challenges.
PowerPyx advises leaving challenges for one of your last tasks.
On Xbox it is worth 5 of the list's 1,000 Gamerscore.
On GTABase's weighted checklist, the challenges line is worth 1%.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges; the game holds 80, the checklist wants 70.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

steps.t: Complete 50 challenges, as the official description requires; move the counter only on a completed challenge, not an attempted one.
Take the most straightforward 50 for this trophy; the rest still count toward A Long Road, whose checklist asks for 70 of 80.
Sweep the Combat and Criminal categories first: their short timers suit the story's robbery route.
Take Exploration and Fitness next: scans, climbs and swims you are already doing for other trophies.
Let Shopping and Sports accumulate through normal play: spending, hoops, pool and golf all count.
Finish with Survival and Vehicle, and skip the 10 slowest challenges in the game entirely.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.

facts.t: Its official description reads: “Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.”
It is a bronze trophy.
It is not hidden on PlayStation.
The earliest chance is after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when the leads can free-roam together.
You call your partner by holding right on the pad and pressing triangle.
The trophy pops when you leave the red heat zone, not the flashing search area.
A train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is the published escape route.
Bank vault robberies raise a 4-star level automatically, so this can pop during Stage 4.
A fast motorcycle is the recommended getaway vehicle.
No source flags it missable.

trophies.guide: With your partner, raise a wanted level to 4 stars, then lose it.
trophies.name: Hot Together

steps.t: While you are with your partner, raise the wanted level to 4 stars, as the official description requires.
Lose the heat completely without being caught; set it up in open country where you can break line of sight and swap vehicles, not under mission pressure.
Call your partner first (hold right, press triangle): solo escapes do not count.
Ride the train tunnel north of Ambrosia: police struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you.
Keep going until you are out of the red heat zone; that exit, not the search area, is what pops it.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.

facts.t: Its official description reads: “Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.”
It is a bronze trophy.
It is not hidden on PlayStation.
It needs both leads together, so it opens after Chapter 2's Coffee Break.
The wanted level must stay at the flashing stage, not drop, between shops.
The three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City are the published spot.
Those stores open after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.
The trophy can pop about half a minute after leaving the third shop.
PowerPyx suggests robbing the back-room safe in each store to make it register.
An armored vest, sticky bombs and healing items are the recommended kit.

trophies.guide: Rob three shops in a row with your partner in one wanted run.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

steps.t: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back, as the official description requires.
The wanted level must stay up between shops, so plan a tight triangle of shops and keep moving; do not hide long enough for the heat to drop between the second and third robbery.
Gear up first: armored vest, sticky bombs and something to heal with, all from Ammu-Nation.
Use the three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City once Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs has opened them.
Loot a couple of items and the back-room safe in each store; if it has not popped after the third, hit a fourth and keep the run alive.

trophies.disagreement: PowerPyx's database and The Games Wiki's vehicle database both count 280 standout vehicles [7][18]. Its collectibles table counts 281 in 25 categories — the gap sits in Street Racer, 17 in one tally, 16 in the other [18]. Standouts do not count toward this trophy.

facts.t: Its official description reads: “Discover 100 vehicles.”
It is a bronze trophy.
It is not hidden on PlayStation.
A WAiNK scan discovers a vehicle; you do not need to drive it.
The game launched with 557 vehicles in total.
277 of them are base models; the checklist wants 200 of those scanned.
Cars make up 157 of the base models.
Bikes add 29, watercraft 28 and aircraft 16 base models.
Different regions stock different traffic: supercars near Ocean Beach hotels, trucks at Port Gellhorn.
Progress sits under Progress > Vehicles, by category.
On Xbox it is worth 20 of the list's 1,000 Gamerscore.
Boats and aircraft can be scanned as well as road vehicles.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them as you meet them; the 100% discovery list counts 200 base models.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

steps.t: Discover 100 different vehicles, as the official description requires.
Scan unfamiliar vehicles with WAiNK as you meet them from Chapter 1; the checklist counts 200 base models, so this trophy's 100 should come naturally.
Stand on a busy road and scan passing traffic: scanning is enough, no driving needed.
Sweep by category: cars first, then bikes, watercraft at the marinas and aircraft at the airfields.
Change regions when the count stalls: each area stocks different vehicles.
Skip the standout vehicles for this counter: only base models count.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.

facts.t: Its official description reads: “Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.”
It is a bronze trophy.
It is not hidden on PlayStation.
Combat Focus is triggered with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm.
It slows time and highlights vulnerable spots on enemies.
It drains the purple Focus bar under your health and stamina.
Focus has 4 levels, raised by ranges, golf, pool, fishing, headshots and meditation.
Adrenaline extends a Focus activation.
PowerPyx says the trophy does not work on soldiers, police or civilians.
An assault rifle such as the Duke 556 is the recommended weapon.
A Combat challenge, Headshots, uses the same mechanic: 4 headshot kills in one Focus use.

trophies.guide: Drop 5 enemies inside one Combat Focus activation; a second activation does not count.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

steps.t: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus, as the official description requires.
Set it up where enemies cluster, such as a gang operation or a robbery gone loud, and line up your targets before you trigger Focus.
Buff your Focus first with food, a shower or Adrenaline, so the activation lasts long enough.
Wear body armor and walk out of cover toward the group: the window is only a few seconds.
If it will not come, grind Focus to level 4 through ranges and meditation first; the longer bar makes it routine.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.

facts.t: Its official description reads: “Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.”
It is a bronze trophy.
PlayStation hides it until earned.
VCIA is Vice City International Airport.
The plane must be a large passenger jet docked at a boarding bridge, not one parked on the airfield.
The easiest is the jet at departure terminals E3/E4.
Stairs beside the bridge lead through a door straight into the plane.
The cockpit is reached by going upstairs inside the plane.
The trophy pops after flying about 1 km away from the airport.
The airport stays open in free roam, so no source flags it missable.

trophies.guide: At VCIA, steal a passenger plane docked at a departure terminal and fly it out (PowerPyx: E3/E4).
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

steps.t: At VCIA, take off in an aircraft you were not cleared to take — an unscheduled departure, in the official description's words.
The airport stays open in free roam, so this app does not flag it missable; it is hidden, so do not expect the game to hint at it.
Head for the jet docked at terminals E3/E4: drive through the airfield fence and use the stairs by the boarding bridge to get inside.
Go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse the plane out to the airstrip and take off.
Keep flying: the unlock is delayed until you are roughly 1 km from the airport.

facts.t: Its official description reads: “Kinda hot in these Rhinos.”
It is a bronze trophy.
PlayStation hides it until earned.
Rhinos are the game's military tanks.
The tanks stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station.
The base is an island at the south-west edge of the map, in Mariana County.
Entry is through the gate, or by the stunt jump by the south-east entrance.
The trophy unlocks after you enter a tank and shoot some enemies.
A Hauners Rhino Tank is also a Survival challenge reward spawn.
No source flags it missable; the base stays in free roam.

trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino tank from Mile Zero Air Station and shoot enemies until it pops (PowerPyx pins base and method).
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

steps.t: The honest reading of the official description is that it involves a Rhino tank; PowerPyx's current guide confirms the method below.
Try it in free roam where a tank can be taken without a mission failing you for it, and keep a manual save first.
Go to Mile Zero Air Station, the island base at the map's south-west edge, and head for the tanks in its south.
Get in a tank and shoot enemies until the trophy unlocks.
Fight from inside the tank until it pops: leaving it to shoot on foot is not the published method.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.

facts.t: Its official description reads: “Rob a jewelry store without being detected.”
It is a bronze trophy.
It is not hidden on PlayStation.
Jewelry stores unlock in Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.
That quest also gives you the Snap Gun, which opens alarmed doors silently.
The stealth entry is the store's back door.
A note in the back room holds the safe code.
The security footage and the alarm in the back room must also be dealt with.
Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is the published location.
The trophy unlocks shortly after you leave the store.

trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store and get away undetected, from entry to exit.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

steps.t: Rob a jewelry store without being detected, as the official description requires.
Go in quietly, keep weapons down until the till is empty, and leave without tripping an alarm or a witness call; being spotted at any point is what the description forbids.
Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs first: it unlocks both the stores and the Snap Gun for silent entry.
Enter by the back door with the Snap Gun, find the safe-code note, and loot the safe.
Destroy the security footage and disable the alarm in the back room before you leave; Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds is the set-up the guides use.

trophies.disagreement: Trophy: 5 vaults robbed and escaped [6]. Checklist: all 8 vaults hit [7][24]. Rob all 8 and this silver is automatic.

facts.t: Its official description reads: “Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape.”
It is a silver trophy.
It is not hidden on PlayStation.
There are 8 large banks with vaults.
Vaults unlock with Chapter 4's optional mission That's Where The Money Is…
A vault opens when a security van's guard carries cash into the bank.
You cannot carry all the cash alone; your partner takes a bag.
Yasmani sells security van tips for $10,000 once his earlier quests are done.
A vault robbery raises an instant 4-star wanted level.
One large bank can pay up to $205,000 in a single run.
On GTABase's weighted checklist, the vaults line is worth 2%.
The first vault is robbed inside the unlock mission itself.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each; the checklist counts 8 vaults hit.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

steps.t: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one; a vault you are caught in does not count.
Keep going afterwards if you are chasing A Long Road: its checklist counts 8 vaults hit, so this silver is the front end of that requirement.
Finish That's Where The Money Is… in Chapter 4: the first vault is robbed inside the mission itself.
Afterwards, tail a security van (or buy Yasmani's $10,000 tips) and enter while the vault stands open.
Bring your partner and hand off a bag when yours is full; solo carrying leaves cash behind.
Escape on a fast motorcycle through traffic, then swap vehicles to go anonymous.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.

facts.t: Its official description reads: “Rob an Armored Truck and escape.”
It is a bronze trophy.
It is not hidden on PlayStation.
It unlocks automatically inside Chapter 4's That's Where The Money Is… mission.
Robbing a large bank's vault counts as robbing the armored truck that fed it.
An earlier route exists: block a truck near a bank and blow its back door with a sticky bomb.
Sticky bombs are found at the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.
Yasmani becomes a fence in Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.
The trophy pops only after you escape the red heat radius.
One truck is enough; no streak is required.

trophies.guide: Rob one armored truck and escape; one truck is enough.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

steps.t: Rob one armored truck and escape, as the official description requires.
Pick a truck on a quiet road where the escape route is short; you do not need a streak.
The free route: play That's Where The Money Is… in Chapter 4 and this pops inside the vault tutorial.
The early route: block a truck near a bank, sticky-bomb its back door, take the cash and escape the heat radius.
Missed the mission route? Robbing a bank vault also counts as robbing the truck that fed it — escape the heat and it pops.

trophies.disagreement: PlayStation tracks this trophy as 52 areas explored [4]. PowerPyx ignores area counting: fully unfog the whole map, best done by plane [1]. Fly the fog off and both readings are satisfied.

facts.t: Its official description reads: “Explore all of Leonida.”
It is a bronze trophy.
It is not hidden on PlayStation.
PlayStation tracks the requirement as 52 areas.
PowerPyx's method is to unfog the entire map from the air.
Leonida is made up of counties including Mariana, Kelly, Lummox and Leonard.
Vice City and Ocean Beach sit in the east of the map.
Most of the map opens through the story and the 100% run.
No source flags it missable.
Leonida has 5 counties; the challenge list uses all five.

trophies.guide: Visit all 52 Leonida areas; the counter tracks the out-of-the-way ones nothing else sends you to.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

steps.t: Explore all of Leonida: PlayStation tracks this as 52 areas.
Most of the state opens through the story and the 100% run; sweep the leftover areas last, because those are the ones this trophy is really about.
Take a plane and fly the black fog off the map in strips; that is the method the guides publish.
Finish with the corners nothing else visits: the far islands and the northern countryside.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.disagreement: Trophy: one operation per gang, 9 in all [6]. Checklist: all 39 gang operations cleared [7][24]. Clear them all and this is automatic. Respec's operation list totals 40 including non-gang criminal operations [68]; The Games Wiki counts 39 in the standard game and keeps the Ultimate Edition compound out of gang progress [69].

facts.t: Its official description reads: “Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.”
It is a bronze trophy.
It is not hidden on PlayStation.
There are 9 gangs and 39 illegal operations.
Operations are marked with yellow icons when you come near.
19 of them are marked automatically by story progress.
Clearing one means looting all of its key valuables.
A missed valuable is not lost: the operation respawns, but slowly.
The 100% checklist demands all 39 cleared.
Per-gang progress is tracked under Progress > Gangs.
On GTABase's weighted checklist, the gang operations line is worth 3%.
Gang operations are also where the luxury watches behind Discovered Styles usually sit.

trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation of each of the 9 gangs; variety is the requirement, not volume.
trophies.name: Pest Control

steps.t: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang, as the official description requires: PlayStation tracks 9 gangs.
Nine robberies of the same gang do nothing, so keep the per-gang count here and spread the hits across the gang map; the 100% checklist separately counts 39 gang operations cleared.
Loot every key valuable on the first visit: the map icon shows how many each operation holds, and respawns take a long time.
Use the 19 story-marked operations as your spine, then hunt the unmarked ones by their yellow icons.
Check Progress > Gangs when one gang will not tick: it shows how many of theirs you have robbed.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.disagreement: GameMapa's list (18 November) counts In The Beginning… among five hidden trophies unsolved [22]. PowerPyx's current guide gives the method: the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, an Apple Martini, drunk standing next to the bar [1].

facts.t: Its official description reads: “Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.”
It is a bronze trophy.
PlayStation hides it until earned.
The place is the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach.
The drink is an Apple Martini.
You drink it standing next to the bar.
Ocean Beach is the hotel strip in the east of Vice City.
GameMapa's launch list counted it among five unsolved hidden trophies, and KeenGamer's guide still marks its method unconfirmed.
No source flags it missable or chapter-bound.

trophies.guide: Buy an Apple Martini at the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, Ocean Beach, and drink it by the bar.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

steps.t: Go to Ocean Beach and have the cocktail where drinks are served with a view, as the official description names the place and the drink.
The exact bar is now pinned down: the Ocean View Rooftop Bar. Buy the Apple Martini there.
Drink it standing next to the bar; walking away with it is not the trigger.
Do it in free roam whenever you like: no source ties the cocktail to a chapter or flags it missable.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.disagreement: GameMapa's list (18 November) counts Capital Offense among five hidden trophies unsolved [22]. PowerPyx's current guide gives the method: the blue Banshee in the southern Vice City showroom, taken with the Key Cloner, driven through the window [1].

facts.t: Its official description reads: “Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.”
It is a bronze trophy.
PlayStation hides it until earned.
Only one car works: the blue Banshee in the showroom in the south of Vice City.
Stealing it needs the Key Cloner, from Chapter 3's Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs.
The exit is through the showroom window, not the door.
The unlock is slightly delayed until you have driven further down the street.
PowerPyx calls it an easter egg reference to the Banshee in GTA III.
GameMapa's launch list counted it among five unsolved hidden trophies, and KeenGamer's guide still marks its method unconfirmed.
No other showroom car substitutes for it.

trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee in the south Vice City showroom and drive it out the window; it needs the Chapter 3 Key Cloner.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

steps.t: In a vehicle showroom, get into a car and drive out through the glass, as the official description requires — the exit is the trophy, not a purchase.
Get the Key Cloner first, in Chapter 3's Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs: without it the car cannot be taken.
Go to the showroom in the south of Vice City and hack into the blue Banshee specifically.
Drive straight through the window and keep going; the pop is delayed until you are down the street.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.

facts.t: Its official description reads: “Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.”
It is a bronze trophy.
PlayStation hides it until earned.
The alley is Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, run as a gang operation.
It is visited in Chapter 2's optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling.
The trophy needs all 3 of the operation's key valuables stolen.
They are a luxury watch, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun variant and the office safe.
The safe's code is 0300; sticky bombs also open it.
The trophy pops after you escape the police, not on the third pickup.
Missed valuables can be taken later when the operation respawns, so it is not missable.
Kingpin Bowling counts as one of the 39 gang operations.
Its shotgun is one of the game's 130 unique weapon variants.

trophies.guide: Not a bowling game: steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling, a Port Gellhorn gang operation, and escape.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

steps.t: Play the bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley named in the official description, and finish it.
The trophy title is the old series in-joke, but the named alley in the description is the actual requirement.
Go to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — it is a gang operation, marked during Chapter 2's Hit Kingpin Bowling.
Take the luxury watch from the south-east office and the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun from the table in the north-east corner.
Loot the safe in the north-east hallway office (code 0300, or sticky bombs), then escape the police to make it pop.

facts.t: Its official description reads: “A partnership with mass appeal.”
It is a bronze trophy.
PlayStation hides it until earned.
The trigger is maximum Strength on both characters at once.
Strength is checked under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (heart icon).
Training starts after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when both leads are playable.
Working out together trains both at once: the idle partner completes their training automatically.
Fitness clubs are filtered under Map > Activities and cover Vice City.
You can also work out at home after the story.
A Fitness challenge separately asks for Strength Level 4 held by both for 5 days.

trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both leads at once; train together — the partner trains while one works out.
trophies.name: Personal Best

steps.t: No confirmed trigger existed in the launch sources; PowerPyx's current guide confirms it is maximum Strength on both leads — the steps below follow it.
It sits with the partner feats in Stage 3, so work Hot Together and Retail Therapy with your partner first, and keep a manual save before joint story beats.
After Coffee Break, call your partner and buy a fitness club membership; always train as a pair.
Keep going until the Strength line is maxed for Jason and for Lucia at the same time, checking under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia.
Train as a pair every session: working out together trains both leads at once, so neither character lags behind.

trophies.disagreement: The description frames it as “Choices made (for better or worse)” [6]. PowerPyx and GameMapa read the counter as 500 actions affecting your Criminal Profile — stealth finishes, incapacitations, kills and worse each move it [1][22]. This counter follows that reading.

facts.t: Its official description reads: “Choices made (for better or worse).”
It is a bronze trophy.
PlayStation hides it until earned.
The counter runs to 500, visible by clicking the trophy in the trophy list.
What counts is actions that affect your Criminal Profile.
The profile tiers run Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho and Irredeemable.
Irredeemable is permanent once reached.
Profile notifications can be switched on under Settings > UI > HUD Notifications.
Every robbery and enemy encounter adds to the count.
PowerPyx expects it to complete passively during the other trophies.
On Xbox it is worth 5 of the list's 1,000 Gamerscore.

trophies.guide: Count-driven: 500 Criminal Profile actions, accumulated through normal play — every robbery and encounter counts.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

steps.t: Make the dialogue and story choices the game offers instead of skipping them; PlayStation tracks this count to 500.
If the count stalls late, choices in side strands are the remaining pool; the exact choice list is not published in the sources we read.
Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications) so you can see each action register.
Just play the robbery route: stealth finishes, escapes and encounters all move the profile, and 500 arrives on its own.

trophies.disagreement: GameMapa's list (18 November) counts Bad Luck, I Guess among five hidden trophies unsolved [22]. PowerPyx's current guide gives the method: the Little Cuba Payday Loans from the Prologue, robbed again as Lucia alone, escaping on foot [1].

facts.t: Its official description reads: “Second time's the charm.”
It is a bronze trophy.
PlayStation hides it until earned.
In the Prologue, Lucia robs a Payday Loans store.
The trophy is robbing that same store again, later, as Lucia.
The store is the Payday Loans in Little Cuba, Vice City.
The earliest attempt is after Chapter 3's Credit Check unlocks payday robberies.
You must come alone as Lucia, without Jason.
The escape must be on foot; driving away does not unlock it.
GameMapa's launch list counted it among five unsolved hidden trophies, and KeenGamer's guide still marks its method unconfirmed.

trophies.guide: Recreate the Prologue: rob Little Cuba Payday Loans again as Lucia alone, and escape on foot.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

steps.t: No source we read at launch confirmed which attempt this meant; PowerPyx's current guide confirms the Prologue recreation below.
Retry failed challenges, races and range attempts immediately rather than moving on: a succeed-on-a-second-try trigger can only be met by making a second try.
After Credit Check in Chapter 3, go alone as Lucia to the Payday Loans in Little Cuba — the store from the Prologue.
Rob it fully (the teller, the security, the 3 cash drawers), then run: the unlock needs an on-foot escape from the search area.

trophies.disagreement: KeenGamer lists this unlock method as unconfirmed [9]; GameMapa counts it among five unsolved hidden trophies [22]. PowerPyx documents the UFO easter egg — place, time and steps [1].

facts.t: Its official description reads: “What the hell just happened?”
It is a bronze trophy.
PlayStation hides it until earned.
The trigger is the game's UFO easter egg.
The spot is the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County.
It happens at night, after 2 AM, and you must be solo.
A blinking car at the roadside is the tell; the spawn is not guaranteed.
The UFO appears as a bright blue light over the woods path.
The trophy completes after you help the woman it drops back to her car.
KeenGamer's guide still lists the method as unconfirmed.

trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg: the blinking car north-west of the Starlet Motel, at night after 2 AM, alone.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

steps.t: Explore odd map markers and stranger content: the description gives nothing else away, and launch coverage marked this trophy not yet known.
No location was claimed for this one at launch, because no source then pinned the event down.
Go solo, after 2 AM, to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County and look for a blinking car; if it is absent, leave and return.
Follow the path into the woods toward the blue light and approach the UFO until it drops the woman.
Talk to her, offer help, and walk her back to her car at the roadside to finish it.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.disagreement: KeenGamer says the method is still being confirmed [9]; GameMapa counts Ten Pin among five unsolved hidden trophies [22]. PowerPyx gives the method: kick 10 pedestrians from a bike within 60 seconds [1]. The other labels are shown alongside.

facts.t: Its official description reads: “Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.”
It is a bronze trophy.
PlayStation hides it until earned.
The method is kicking pedestrians from a moving bike.
It takes 10 kicks inside 60 seconds.
The kick is on the square button while riding.
Crowded areas such as Vice City and Ocean Beach are the published spots.
Despite the name, no bowling is involved.
KeenGamer's guide still calls the precise method unconfirmed.
GameMapa's launch list counted it among five unsolved hidden trophies, and KeenGamer's guide still marks its method unconfirmed.

trophies.guide: Ride a bike through a crowd and kick 10 pedestrians in 60 seconds. Despite the name, no bowling is involved.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

steps.t: From a moving vehicle, strike a pedestrian with a melee attack as you pass, exactly as the official description says.
Set it up on a quiet street at low speed where one clean pass is easy to judge; despite the bowling pun in its name, no bowling is involved.
Use a bike in a crowded place — Vice City or Ocean Beach — and kick (square) as you pass each pedestrian.
Chain 10 kicks inside one 60-second window; if the window lapses, restart the run on the same street.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.

facts.t: Its official description reads: “Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.”
It is a bronze trophy.
It is not hidden on PlayStation.
The total is cumulative across all robberies, not one delivery.
Marked bills come from banks and payday loans.
Fencing them needs the Dye Pack Jammer from Chapter 3's Credit Check.
Yasmani in Vice City pays the most for them.
The 100% checklist carries the same $250,000 marked bills line.
Bank vaults are the fast source, paying up to $205,000 a run.
Vaults only open from Chapter 4, so early progress comes from ordinary bank jobs.
On GTABase's weighted checklist, the marked bills line is worth 2%.
A single large-bank vault can hold over $200,000 in marked bills.

trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts — a pipeline, not one score.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

steps.t: Launder marked bills through your contacts until the cumulative total reaches $250,000, as the official description requires; the 100% checklist counts the same $250,000 fenced.
Feed marked bills into laundering whenever you hold them and keep the running total here in dollars; expect it to finish during Stage 4's money work rather than in the story.
Unlock the pipeline in Chapter 3: Credit Check gives you the Dye Pack Jammer, without which marked bills cannot be fenced.
Sell to Yasmani in Vice City where you can: the guides say he pays the most.
Rob banks and payday loans for the bills, then fence them promptly: the total is a running one, so steady Stage 4 income finishes it.

facts.t: Its official description reads: “Spend $100,000 across all shops.”
It is a bronze trophy.
It is not hidden on PlayStation.
The spend is cumulative and spread across all shop types.
The map holds 24 Ammu-Nations, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays and 14 mod shops.
It also holds 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores and 18 hair salons.
Tattoo studios number 11 and electronics stores 15.
Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest spend, being the priciest.
Spending $50,000 at Ammu-Nations is itself one of the Shopping challenges.
Spending challenges in the Shopping category stack on the same purchases.
No source flags it missable.

trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative $100,000 across all shops, not in one place.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

steps.t: Spend $100,000 across all shops in total, as the official description requires — cumulative, and spread across shops.
Buy vehicles, weapons, clothes and property fittings as you go instead of hoarding cash: normal platinum spending passes this total on its own.
Aim your platinum purchases at the expensive counters first: weapons at Ammu-Nation, mods at the mod shops, tattoos at the studios.
Let the Shopping challenges ride along: the same spending feeds several of them.
Find shops fast with the map's Touch Pad > Style filter when you are hunting a specific counter.

trophies.disagreement: The description says “Purchase all garage properties” [6]. PowerPyx clarifies: 8 purchasable garages plus 4 story ones, only the 8 count [1]; GTAScoop and KeenGamer say the same [21][9]. This counter tracks the 8.

facts.t: Its official description reads: “Purchase all garage properties.”
It is a bronze trophy.
It is not hidden on PlayStation.
PlayStation tracks 8 purchasable garages.
There are also 4 story-related garages, which do not count.
The 8 together cost $160,000.
Garages open for purchase after Chapter 2's Daily Driver.

steps.t: Purchase all garage properties; PlayStation tracks 8 of them.
Tick each garage here as you buy it, because the map alone does not make the missing one obvious.
Wait for the Vice City Real Estate app, installed after Chapter 2's Daily Driver, then buy through the phone.
Budget $160,000 for the full set; robbery income from Chapters 3–4 covers it without farming.
Buy through the Vice City Real Estate app on the phone: all eight garages are listed there with their prices.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.

facts.t: Its official description reads: “Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.”
It is a bronze trophy.
It is not hidden on PlayStation.
The app is installed after Chapter 2's Moses mission.
Registration happens at Moses' garage in Port Gellhorn: Respray, then Register.
Each garage you own adds parking spots to register more vehicles.
At first only tracker-free vehicles are accepted.
From Chapter 3, standard-tracker cars can be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray.
Registering costs money per vehicle.
Registered vehicles can be delivered to you anywhere through the app.
Moses' garage, where registrations happen, is in Port Gellhorn.

trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — registrations, not discoveries (Whip It Good).
trophies.name: On the Spot

steps.t: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, as the official description requires.
Register vehicles you actually keep and use as you acquire them during the story and money stages, and the tenth registration will land long before the platinum cleanup.
Buy garages first if the app says you are out of spots: each garage adds registration space.
Keep costs down with cheap low-end cars and bikes; the app does not care what you register.
From Chapter 3, any Pay 'n' Spray or Mod Shop can register standard-tracker cars — you do not have to return to Moses' garage.
